verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Lovable offering a way to define event-triggered rules that run actions automatically. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: edge functions and realtime in the generated app's backend are developer building blocks, automatic Git sync and enterprise scheduled Deep scans are fixed built-in behaviors (and a schedule is not an event trigger), and chat-invoked project actions are one-off manual requests.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
